meta-facebook:
Thanks for pointing that out.

This commit adds actions executed when running fanboardpower.
When turning Off, it unbinds the driver, restarts the fan sensor, sets the fan speed, and disables slot power.
When turning On, it binds the driver, restarts the fan sensor, and enables slot power.

Hi @patrick@stwcx.xyz @geissonator@yahoo.com @amithash@meta.com @pmb@meta.com,

This commit adds follow-up actions when enabling fan board power, setting the fan to 100% and turning off the slot power. If you have time, could you please help review it? Thanks!
